name: com.docme.shader-ui
description: An attribute-driven material inspector for built-in pipeline shaders: collapsible sections, tooltips, help boxes, search, conditional properties, section toggles and a banner with links, all from the shader's Properties block and an optional config asset. No per-shader inspector code. Older DocMe shaders from Booth put a copy in Assets/DocMe/ShaderUI, so delete that folder before adding this package.
